objs.name: document
objs.description: Core managed artifact representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, or work instructions that go through creation, editing, release, distribution, and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type-based abbreviation prefix with consecutive number identifying the document.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g., policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid the document belongs to.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g., editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number tracking revisions of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released document version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document version remains valid.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which an invalidated document is retained before physical deletion.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Areas of validity or relevant companies for which the document applies.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Language in which the document content is maintained.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents, master data, IT applications, or processes.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications referenced by the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or organizational areas to which the document applies.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled supplementary document linked to a main document, subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment within the release process.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary non-controlled information object added to a document that is not subject to a release cycle.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the additional info is directly published via property switches.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal for changing an existing released document, managed separately without affecting the document's content or version until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the change proposal (e.g., created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: System-generated request triggered 30 days before document validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend, revise, or invalidate.

attributes.name: period
attributes.description: Default period for validity extension, typically 3 years per document type.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request to invalidate a document and withdraw it from circulation, triggering archiving of the document and its attachments.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request to re-validate a previously invalidated (archived) document, restoring its status and authorizations.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual person who interacts with documents in the system under one or more assigned roles.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to the user (e.g., Reader, Author, Co-Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Named group of users used to assign collective read or change authorizations to documents.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Classification of the group (e.g., Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups and individual persons assigned to a document for email notification or acknowledgement upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by email notification or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported process instance that drives approval, review, release, validity extension, override, or reactivation steps.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Current step in the workflow (e.g., Creator, Review, Release).

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Predefined template associated with a document type, used when creating new documents to provide structure and TAG-based metadata fields.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Digital signature provided by a workflow participant to confirm completion of a workflow step.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: Person who provided the signature.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the signature was provided.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Tenant or organizational entity in a multi-client system where documents can be made visible or local additions created.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document is created by attaching a new information object with selection of the corresponding document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The type selected during creation.

attributes.name: template_used
attributes.description: The template selected for the new document, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: The saved document is automatically converted to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval workflow (Creator-Review-Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_as_creator
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document content for technical and/or formal correctness.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Whether the review is technical, formal, or both.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves the document for publication and distribution to readers.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the approval workflow, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

attributes.name: rejection_step
attributes.description: Workflow step at which the rejection occurred (Review or Release).

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created for revision, retaining data from the previous version.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: A controlled attachment is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving; actual archiving occurs upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is added to a document without affecting the document's version.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is removed from a document without affecting the document's version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A user with author rights creates a change proposal for an existing released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the associated document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the completion of an assigned change proposal, notifying the proposal creator.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically creates a validity extension request 30 days before the document's valid-until date.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: The releaser (and optionally author/reviewer) processes the validity extension request via workflow to extend the document's validity.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The document's validity is confirmed and the valid-until date is updated by the default period.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document and withdraw it from circulation.

evts.name: process_override_request
evts.description: The override request is processed through a workflow (releaser-only or 3-step with initiator, reviewer, releaser).

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is declared out of force, its status is updated, existing editing versions are deleted, and all rights except archive group are revoked.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A member of the Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate a previously invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: The initiator confirms reactivation, creating a new version of the archived document with restored metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are notified by email upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are requested by email to actively confirm acknowledgement upon document release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a released document via a workflow task without signature.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or change authorizations are assigned to user groups or individual persons for a document.

attributes.name: authorization_type
attributes.description: Type of authorization assigned (read or change).

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language by a translator.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: Language into which the document is translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated language version is checked and released via workflow, making it visible to readers in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system sends an email notification to relevant users about workflow tasks, status changes, or distribution events.

attributes.name: notification_type
attributes.description: Type of notification (e.g., workflow task, validity extension, override, acknowledgement).

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive duration expires, the archived document is physically deleted from the system.

o2o.description: An attachment is a controlled supplementary document linked to and versioned with a main document.
Additional information objects are non-controlled supplements added to a document.
A change proposal belongs to and is displayed within a specific document.
A validity extension request is linked to the document whose validity needs to be checked.
An override request is linked to the document to be invalidated.
A reactivation request references the invalidated document to be reactivated.
A document can reference other documents via the references attribute.
One or more templates can be defined per document type and selected when creating a document.
A distribution list is maintained per document to control email and acknowledgement distribution.
Users are assigned to user groups which grant them collective authorizations and roles.
User groups are assigned to a document's distribution list for notification or acknowledgement.
Individual persons can be directly assigned to a document's distribution list.
In a multi-client system, a document's visibility is specified per client.
